event.description:
!! Event will be held at The Sint-Paulus School (Entrance: Strop straat 122 through the white gate)           Which is a 5 min walk from the store !!                                                                 Join the Grand Archive Regionals at Outpost Ghent! The highest level event in Belgium will allow participants to battle it out for some amazing prizes, including a Nationals Invite!

Due to a limited amount of spots, reservation is needed! You can reserve your spot by filling out the following form:
https://forms.gle/kMKPA7sqKcTwGS736

Doors: 10:00
Start: 11:00
Entry: 30€

Number of rounds (swiss only and NO top cut):
9 - 16 players: 4 rounds
17 - 32 players: 5 rounds
33 - 64 players: 6 rounds
65 - 80 players: 7 rounds

Participation Prizes:
- 1 Binder
- 1 Sapphire Pack
- 2 Event packs
- 3 boosters PTM

TOP 16 prize support:
1st: 1 winner playmat + 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 5 Sapphire packs + 6 event packs + 1 box PTM

2nd: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 5 Sapphire packs + 6 event packs + 1 box PTM

3rd – 4th: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 3 Sapphire packs + 4 event packs + 10 boosters PTM

5th – 8th: 1 finalist playmat + 1 invite card + 2 Sapphire packs + 3 event packs + 5 boosters PTM

9th – 16th: 1 Sapphire pack + 1 booster PTM

Deck Construction Rules: 
Min 60-card main deck
Max 12 card material deck
15 point sideboard (Main deck card = 1p, material deck card =3p)

(Players are required to submit their decklist on Omnidex before the event begins.)

Format:
- Best 2 out of 3
- 60 minutes/round
- 5 minutes overtime (3 turns)

-------------------------
Join the Outpost Ghent Discord to stay in touch with fellow players:
https://discord.com/invite/RUnm7x83zH
